# Azure Networking Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Azure

## Overview

Designs Azure networking with VNets, NSGs, Application Gateway, and Front Door for secure and performant cloud infrastructure

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [azure-networking-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
azure-networking-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@azure-networking-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design VNet with proper subnet planning
- Configure NSGs with least privilege rules
- Set up Application Gateway with WAF
- Implement Azure Front Door for global routing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Azure Networking**: VNet design and security best practices
- **Application Gateway**: L7 load balancing with WAF
- **Private Link**: Private connectivity to Azure services
